title: Against the Current

story.logline: A fish leaves its enormous school and ventures into the unknown, visualising an education brand's promise to create an independent path.
story.character_goal: The fish wants to leave the safety of the group and choose its own path.
story.obstacle: The school provides safety and social pressure; the unknown creates risk.
story.turning_choice: The fish deliberately swims away from the group instead of following the current.
story.result: The departure becomes a metaphor for entrepreneurship and the school brand's international path.

beats.visible_action: Establish a large school moving together in a marine environment.
beats.state_out: the group becomes a visual force
beats.evidence: campaign synopsis describes an enormous school

beats.visible_action: Single fish separates from the school.
beats.evidence: the fish decides to venture alone

beats.visible_action: Fish moves through an unknown marine environment.
beats.evidence: the film translates courage and creating one's own path into the journey

beats.visible_action: The journey resolves into the education brand's arrival and entrepreneurial promise.
beats.state_out: metaphor is assigned to the brand
beats.evidence: campaign communicates Link School of Business entering Miami

rules_observed: A metaphor works when the character action is simple, irreversible and directly maps to the brand promise.
anti_patterns: The brand must be connected before the metaphor becomes a decorative visual effect.
quality_notes: Useful no-dialogue model; product/service connection arrives through the campaign concept rather than a literal product demonstration.
